title.rendered: MBT in “A Week Without Sugar”

content.rendered:
As part of its commitment to social responsibility and community health, MBT Group, in collaboration with Abdul Latif Jameel Hospital in Saudi Arabia, took part in the “A Week Without Sugar” initiative.

During the event, samples of the locally produced Monk Fruit—a safe and healthy third-generation sugar alternative—were distributed to employees and visitors.

Through this meaningful participation, MBT Group reaffirms its dedication to supporting health awareness programs, encouraging healthier lifestyle choices, and contributing to a future with better well-being for the community.

title.rendered: Indonesian Trade Delegation Visits MBT, Jeddah

content.rendered: As a prominent Saudi trading partner with Indonesian enterprises, MBT was privileged to host Mrs. Fajriyani, Director of the Export Development Directorate of Indonesia, along with her official government delegation. The discussions centered on identifying collaborative opportunities and fortifying commercial partnerships between MBT and Indonesian firms, with the goal of delivering strategic advantages for both parties.

title.rendered: Business & Social Responsibility

content.rendered: As part of MBT Group’s mission to support the community and encourage healthy living, and in collaboration with Abdul Latif Jameel, the official Toyota dealer in Saudi Arabia, samples of the Indonesian Product ‘Monk Fruit‘—a healthy alternative to sugar and the next-generation safe sweetener—were handed out today to the employees at Auto Hub on Madinah Road, Jeddah. The Abdul Latif Jameel team expressed their appreciation for this initiative and admiration for the product, wishing all participants ongoing health and wellness.

Mohammed Bawazir Trading Company Ltd. | Primaduta Award 2024

content.rendered:
Mohammed Bawazir Trading Company Ltd.
Primaduta Award 2024

In recognition of its outstanding commitment and performance as the Best Partner and Distributor of Indonesian Products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia for 2024.

Mohammed Bawazir Trading Company Ltd. was honored with the Presidential Primaduta Award 2024 in appreciation of its exceptional dedication and performance in commercial cooperation with Indonesian companies.

         

This award represents the excellence of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in trade with the Republic of Indonesia for the year 2024. It was presented by the Indonesian Consulate in Jeddah to Mohammed Bawazir Trading Company Ltd., in the presence of several distinguished Indonesian partners.
